title: Integration Portfolio Expansion Foundation
goal: Expand enterprise workflow integrations beyond Jira and one handoff while preserving the existing integration safety model.
scope: Implement or prepare the next integration portfolio slice for Slack, Teams, ServiceNow, and generic webhook handoffs using the existing integration configuration and finding-link patterns. Keep background sync workers and shadow workflow engines out of scope unless explicitly promoted later.
generation_reason: Product recommendation coverage audit found named enterprise integrations were not explicitly queued beyond Jira and one generic handoff.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Reuse the existing integration configuration and finding-link pattern. Do not create a second integration engine or background sync lane.
notes: Each external system must be opt-in per engagement or tenant boundary.
Secrets and tokens must use protected secret handling.

success_criteria: The next named integration options are represented through existing configuration patterns or a documented provider interface.
At least one additional integration path can create a controlled handoff without background automation.
Unsupported providers and missing credentials show explicit fallback states.
API/browser tests cover configured, missing, and failed handoff states.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Integration expansion reuses existing configuration and link patterns.
External handoff failures are visible and non-fatal.
No background sync or shadow workflow engine is introduced.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
The next provider or provider interface is selected without reordering earlier queue items.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with integration portfolio changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the integration expansion baseline and remaining provider limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.

out_of_scope: Bypassing approval or runtime binding gates
